title: Which quadrant
observableEvidence: Determines the quadrant of a point from the signs of its x- and y-coordinates.
prompt: Point A is located at (-4, 6) on the coordinate plane. In which quadrant does point A lie?
solutionRepresentation: A negative x-coordinate and a positive y-coordinate place the point in Quadrant II.
solutionMethod: Compare the signs of the x- and y-coordinates to the sign pattern of each quadrant.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept the quadrant name written as a word or a Roman numeral.

hintSteps.prompt: Check whether each coordinate is positive or negative.
hintSteps.question: Is the x-coordinate of point A positive or negative?

hintSteps.prompt: A quadrant with a negative x-coordinate and a positive y-coordinate is the one directly above the negative x-axis, to the upper left of the origin.
hintSteps.question: Is the y-coordinate of point A positive or negative?

hintSteps.prompt: In a similar example, the point (5, -3) has a positive x-coordinate and a negative y-coordinate, so it lies in Quadrant IV.
hintSteps.question: Using that same sign-pattern idea, what do the signs of point A's coordinates tell you about which quadrant it is in?

review.originalityStatement: Written for this repository from first principles.

accessibilityNotes: Present coordinates as plain signed-number text; do not depend on a plotted graph image or color.
